16	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.service;
17	
18	import org.slf4j.Logger;
19	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
20	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
21	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
22	
23	/**
24	 * Emits audit trail entries for {@link Owner} lifecycle events to the dedicated
25	 * {@code AUDIT} logger, keeping audit side-effects separate from request
26	 * handling and persistence logic.
27	 */
28	@Component
29	public class OwnerAuditor {
30	
31	    private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");
32	
33	    /**
34	     * Record that an owner was successfully created, capturing its id, customer
35	     * code, (resolved) registration date and membership level.
36	     *
37	     * @param owner the newly persisted owner
38	     */
39	    public void ownerCreated(Owner owner) {
40	        AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}",
41	            owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(), owner.getMembershipLevel());
42	    }
43	}
44
